question.text: If <math><mi>f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>n</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></math> for <math><mi>n</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mn>3</mn><mo>…</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>.</mo><mo>.</mo></math> and <math><mi>f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math>, then <math><mfrac><mrow><mi>f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>101</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></mfrac></math> is equal to

solution.text:
fn+1=fn+12
⇒fn+1-fn=12
⇒f1,f2,f3…….. are in AP with common difference 12.
f101=f1+100d
=2+100×12=52
⇒f10110=5.2
